description.en: A traditional Emirati dish made with fish or chicken, spices, and a thick wheat-based mixture. It has a soft texture and is often eaten during Ramadan.
description.ja: 魚や鶏肉、香辛料、小麦を使って作るアラブ首長国連邦の伝統料理です。とろみのある柔らかい食感で、ラマダンの時期にもよく食べられています。

ingredients.en: Fish or chicken, wheat flour, onion, garlic, spices, water, and salt.
ingredients.ja: 魚または鶏肉、小麦粉、玉ねぎ、にんにく、香辛料、水、塩。

preparation.en: Cook the fish or chicken with onion, garlic, spices, and water. Add wheat flour gradually while stirring. Simmer and stir until the mixture becomes thick and smooth.
preparation.ja: 魚または鶏肉を玉ねぎ、にんにく、香辛料、水と一緒に煮ます。混ぜながら小麦粉を少しずつ加えます。とろみがつき、なめらかになるまで煮込みます。
